boundary: Stage 24A sonar projects trained readout directions through static output embeddings. It does not prove exact neurons, SAE-disentangled features, raw CAS-symbol understanding, or that the model would generate the listed tokens in free-form decoding.
plain_english_read: This report measures whether the Stage 7 Foundation probe directions have class-specific token signatures in Pythia-160M's output embedding space. It is token-level diagnostic attribution, not open-ended generation control.
